{{Quote|Considering the amount of damage we've sustained, they must have been destroyed.|Captain Lorth Needa|<ref name="ESB" />}}
An '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' served with [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]&mdash;a task force assembled specifically for finding the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|headquarters]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;during the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was commanded by a [[Unidentified Imperial captain (asteroid victim)|captain]]. During the hunt for the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] tower was struck by a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], destroying the [[Warship/Legends|warship]].

==History==
[[File:YouCanProbablyBuffThatOut-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Star Destroyer is hit by an asteroid and subsequently obliterated.]]
Commanded by an [[Unidentified Imperial captain (asteroid victim)|unidentified captain]], this [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] was assigned to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]]&mdash;the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord's]] personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], which he used to track down the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|base of operations]]&mdash;in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" />

When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escaped from the Rebels' [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] with his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|co-pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] aboard his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], he fled into the nearby [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] to escape the pursuing [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. In an effort to capture the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], Vader ordered several Star Destroyers, including this Star Destroyer, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], and the [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], into the unpredictable storm of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] to draw the ''Millennium Falcon'' and its passengers out of their hiding spot, and into the hands of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="ESB" />

This Star Destroyer's [[Captain/Legends|captain]] attended a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] conference of nineteen other [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]], including Captain [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]] of the ''Avenger'', with Vader aboard the ''Executor'' to discuss the status of the elusive ''Millennium Falcon''. As the conference progressed, this Star Destroyer's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] tower was hit by a massive hurtling asteroid,<ref name="ESB" /> and the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] was subsequently obliterated.<ref name="ESB novel" />

==Commanders and crew==
This Star Destroyer was commanded by an unidentified captain. When this ship's bridge tower was hit by an asteroid, the captain was killed.<ref name="ESB novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LargeScaleDodgeball-SW42ALTA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Two Star Destroyers are destroyed in asteroid collisions.]]
Like its unidentified captain, this Star Destroyer first appeared in the [[1980]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In the film, its destruction is not obvious; however, in the novelization and the [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], the warship is specifically mentioned as being obliterated as a result of the collision. In [[Star Wars (1977) 42|''Star Wars'' (1977) 42]], the destruction of this ship and another unidentified Star Destroyer are shown.
